## Distribution

- Package: `@carapace/byteplus-provider`
- Install route: npm or ClawHub: `clawhub:@carapace/byteplus-provider`

## Surface

- Providers: `byteplus`, `byteplus-plan`
- Contracts: `videoGenerationProviders`
